name: com.socalpitch/socal-pitch
title: SoCal Pitch
description: Southern California youth soccer: club directory, tryouts, leagues, tournaments and guides.

tools.name: pitch-find-clubs
tools.description: Search the SoCal Pitch youth soccer club directory for Southern California (10 counties). Filter by county or city, tier (Elite, Competitive, Recreational), league (for example ECNL, MLS NEXT, Girls Academy), gender, or free-text words. Returns each club's location, tier, leagues, website and verification date. Use pitch/list-areas for valid area names.

query.description: Words to look for in the club name, county, city, region, tier and leagues, such as "Surf" or "Albion". Every word must match. Leave out to list all clubs that fit the other filters.

area.description: Where to look: a county or city, county, city or US state name, such as "San Diego", "Boise" or "Colorado". Partial names match. See list-areas for the names this directory uses.

tier.description: Level of play. Elite: national-league clubs such as ECNL, MLS NEXT or Girls Academy. Competitive: travel and club soccer. Recreational: community and AYSO-style programs. A club with teams at more than one level matches each of them.

league.description: A league the club plays in, such as "ECNL", "ECNL RL", "MLS NEXT", "Girls Academy" or "N1L". Partial names match.

gender.description: Only clubs with boys or girls programs. Clubs with both always match.

limit.description: Most results to return, from 1 to 25. Default 10. The response also gives the total number of matches.

tools.name: pitch-list-areas
tools.description: The areas the SoCal Pitch club directory covers (Southern California (10 counties)), with the number of listed clubs in each. Use these names with pitch/find-clubs.

tools.name: pitch-search-guides
tools.description: Search published SoCal Pitch guides, articles and pages: tryouts, leagues, tournaments, camps, costs, gear, standings recaps and club spotlights.

query.description: Words to search for in published guides and articles, such as "tryouts", "Surf Cup" or "club soccer cost".

limit.description: Most results to return, from 1 to 25. Default 10. The response also gives the total number of matches.

tools.name: pitch-get-page
tools.description: Full text of one published SoCal Pitch page or article, as plain text with headings. Pass the URL or slug. Long pages come back in parts: pass next_offset as offset to continue.

url_or_slug.description: The full page URL from a search result, or just its slug, such as "tryouts".

offset.description: Where to resume a long page. Pass the next_offset value from the previous response. Default 0.

tools.name: pitch-whats-new
tools.description: Articles and pages on SoCal Pitch published since a date (default: last 30 days), newest first: standings recaps, club spotlights, tryout and tournament updates.

since.description: Only items published on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the last 30 days.

limit.description: Most results to return, from 1 to 25. Default 10. The response also gives the total number of matches.

tools.name: pitch-about
tools.description: What SoCal Pitch covers, the other Pitch Network regional sites, and how to cite it.
